fusions.name: Sent After It
fusions.desc: Throws the staff at the first enemy within 6 tiles with a hound after it. It deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second, and the hound then worries 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Low at the Hocks
fusions.desc: Sweeps the crook low through a cone 3 tiles long. It deals 4 damage to everything in it, and its damage rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Gate Held Shut
fusions.desc: You bar the way with the staff and pull up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds. A hound fights beside you for 8 seconds, biting for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Works to the Crook
fusions.desc: A bonded herding dog works to the signals of your staff. It bites enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds, and anything it bites moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.
